specification.family_title: Commit outcome unknown to the client
specification.title: The connection is terminated after the last write, before COMMIT
steps: Start a transaction with the framework's ordinary transaction API.
Checkpoint `before-end`: report pg_current_xact_id() and pg_backend_pid(). The runner terminates that backend from its own connection, and waits until it has gone.
Wait settle_ms, so that the driver can observe the closed connection.
End the transaction normally, so that the framework attempts to commit.

invariants.statement: When the client has received no reply to COMMIT, because the connection or the reply was lost, the API does not report a successful commit.
When the client has received no reply to COMMIT, the API does not report a confirmed rollback.

execution.description: Positive control: reads the command tag of PostgreSQL's reply to COMMIT, reports a COMMIT error as a failure, and discards a connection whose ROLLBACK failed.

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

fault.mechanism: pg_terminate_backend(pid), run by the runner from its own connection.
fault.injection_point: After the last write, before the framework sends COMMIT.
fault.preconditions: The PID the adapter reports belongs to the case's database.
fault.expected_server: The backend exits, and its transaction is rolled back.
fault.expected_client: A connection error at COMMIT. No reply to COMMIT can arrive.

knowledge: No reply to COMMIT can arrive: the session ended before the framework tried to commit. The driver could know that it never sent COMMIT, but the framework's API has no way to report that.

api_outcome.contract: The correct control reports committed only when PostgreSQL answers COMMIT with the command tag COMMIT, reports any other tag as a rollback, and reports a COMMIT that raised as a failure. After a failed savepoint rollback, it ends the transaction with ROLLBACK instead of COMMIT.

error.message: Client has encountered a connection error and is not queryable

evaluation.reason: TX-01B.1 held: the API reported: failed; TX-01B.2 held: the API reported: failed

preconditions.description: the runner terminated the backend at before-end, and it had gone before the adapter resumed
PostgreSQL's outcome is the one the case produces (aborted)
